title: The main file: description + steps

body.text: A Skill usually has a main description file (e.g. SKILL.md) stating
'when to use it' + 'what steps to follow'
. The most important part is the
description of when to use this Skill
, because the AI uses that to decide when to pick it up.

example: SKILL.md: 'Use when the user asks to write a formal email' + steps: ask the purpose → draft → adjust tone

title: Supporting files

body.text: Besides the main file, you can add
example files, templates, or reference data
, which the AI pulls in when needed. Tip: write a concise, clear description — don't cram everything into one file until it's cluttered.

example: Skill folder: SKILL.md + template-email.md + 3 examples of good emails

question: What's the most important part of a Skill's main file?

options.text: The description of when to use this Skill

options.text: Write it concise and clear, don't cram everything into one file
